question: Which of the following is NOT an example of web browser?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Facebook**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Browser:

 
• A web browser is a software application for accessing the information on the World Wide Web.
 
• When a user requests a web page from a particular website, the web browser retrieves the necessary content from a web server and then displays the page on the user's device.
 
• It is an application used to access and view websites.
 
• Microsoft Internet Explorer, Maxthon 6 Cloud Browser, Google Chrome, Opera, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, etc. are some of examples of web browser
 
• A web browser is a computer program you use to view web pages
 
• A web browser helps in receiving the web-page matter through the internet.
